WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    f.rating,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) AS films_rented
  FROM rental r
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(films_rented) AS avg_count FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT 
  AVG(rc.films_rented) AS avg_count_above_avg,
  AVG(rc.films_rented - oa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_over_overall_avg
FROM rating_counts rc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
WHERE rc.films_rented > oa.avg_count
